technology.summary: Today's technology news includes a range of topics, from the launch of new products and services to the impact of AI on the future of work. Microsoft has announced its third-generation Maia in-house AI chip, designed to improve the cost and efficiency of running AI workloads in the cloud. Meanwhile, Amazon has over 1 million robot workers, raising questions about the future of human employment. In other news, a former Plaud executive has raised $26 million for an AI app that listens to users in the background, and Fitbit has officially launched the Fitbit Edge, a fitness tracker for those who want notifications without a screen.

finance.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have joined forces to make it easier for foreign portfolio investors to enter the market. The Nifty 50 index closed down by 95.75 points, reaching 22,620.45, due to profit booking and rising oil prices. The BSE Hospitals Index faced a steep 5% drop, leading to notable losses for industry giants like Apollo Hospitals and Fortis Healthcare. A resurgent El Niño pattern risks deepening a selloff in Southeast Asian bonds, threatening to push yields higher just as rising US Treasury rates and oil prices squeeze regional debt.

politics.summary:
Today's most important politics news includes:
- The Delhi High Court dismissed pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence.
- Jairam Ramesh attacked the CEC, a day after Supreme Court judge Justice Ujjal Bhuyan said that any process that "disenfranchises" millions of Indian citizens is "intrinsically arbitrary" and a "negation" of the constitutional order.
- Congress claims that tribal students headed for a Mumbai protest were detained and threatened with police cases.
- A petition was filed to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar.
- Donald Trump cited an Indian election that didn't happen to call the US electoral process "corrupt".
- India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by USD 18.34 billion in a single week.
- Bengali actor Koel Mallick joined the BJP.
